caseName: Jackson v. United States ex rel. Wade
caseNameFull: Jackson, Warden v. United States ex rel. Wade
attorneys: Louis J. Lefkowitz, Attorney General of New York, and Paxton Blair, Solicitor General, for petitioners. Philip C. Potter, Jr. for respondent.
